# BidLab — source map

Local-first tender decision laboratory for Spanish SMEs. Read the current
README and reviewer guide before interpreting historical design notes.

- Product and demo: README.md, docs/demo/README.md
- Current reviewer guide: docs/REVIEWER_GUIDE.md
- Architecture and implemented stack: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Economic/domain invariants: docs/RULE_ENGINE.md
- Current test evidence: docs/QA_REPORT_V2.md, docs/verification-log.md
- V2 design and tradeoffs: docs/DECISION_LOG_V2.md
- Meta status and receipts: docs/META_EVIDENCE_V2.md
- Public limitations and legal caveats: README.md, docs/submission-draft.md
- V2 evidence shots: docs/v2-shots/
- E2E suite (hermetic, loopback-only): tests/e2e/
- Golden oracles: apps/api/tests/integration/test_compare.py,
  scripts/demo_story.py, examples/evaluation_request.json

Verify claims against code/tests and use the commit identified in the report.

## How to run

Install with `uv sync --all-packages` and `npm install`, build the web UI
with `npm run build -w apps/web`, then `python scripts/demo.py --reset-demo`
serves API + built frontend same-origin at http://127.0.0.1:8000/.
`npm run dev -w apps/web` (127.0.0.1:5173) is for frontend development only.
The offline demo needs no keys; Meta live extraction is opt-in via
MODEL_API_KEY and currently blocked (no credential). Full gates:
`python scripts/verify.py` (exit 0 = green).

## Limits

One tender fully modelled; company costs and rival offers are declared
synthetic hypotheses, never inferred distributions. Unknown stays null,
pending rules block points, anomaly verdicts are presumptions, never
exclusions. No win prediction, OCR, or national search; PDFs cap at 20 MB
and 120 pages; originals not redistributed; local-only without multi-user
auth. No remote CI (author's decision); no public deployment claimed.
